data.title: HSBC Announces Results of $1.5 Billion Securities Tender Offer
data.description:
An announcement from HSBC Holdings ( (GB:HSBA) ) is now available.

HSBC Holdings plc announced on 20 November 2026 the results of its cash offer to purchase up to $1,500,000,000 of its outstanding $3,000,000,000 6.000% perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities. The offer expired on 19 November 2026, with accepted securities priced at 100.50% of principal amount.

Holders tendered $1,570,766,000, exceeding the maximum, so HSBC accepted $1,500,000,000 on a 93.27884% prorated basis; total consideration was $1,507,500,000, excluding accrued interest. HSBC also confirmed that its $1,500,000,000 offering of 7.625% perpetual subordinated contingent convertible securities closed on 13 November 2026, satisfying the offer’s New Issue Condition.

data.title: Locate Technologies Reports First Quarterly Net Profit, Locate2u Revenue Up 72%
data.description:
Locate Technologies Limited ( (NZ:LOC) ) just unveiled an announcement.

Locate Technologies is an AI-powered delivery and logistics technology company operating Locate2u, an international route optimisation and delivery management platform, and Zoom2u, an Australian on-demand courier and delivery marketplace. In unaudited Q1 FY27 results, Locate2u revenue rose 72% year on year to NZ$1.50 million and accounted for 67% of Group revenue; the Group also recorded a NZ$62,000 net profit, its first quarterly net profit as a listed company.

The company advised that its 2026 annual meeting would be held virtually on 23 November 2026 and that the meeting materials contained no material information not previously released. Management also said the PURE debt facility had been refinanced in November and that large enterprise customer rollouts were underway.

data.title: Downer awarded approximately $1.1bn NSW transmission contract
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Downer EDI Limited ( (AU:DOW) ).

Downer EDI Limited provides integrated services across Australia and New Zealand, delivering and maintaining infrastructure in sectors including power, energy networks, roads, rail, water, telecommunications, defence and government services. Its market focus includes the energy transition, defence capability, government services, infrastructure expansion and local industry revitalisation.

Downer has been awarded by EnergyCo a contract to work with Transgrid on NSW’s Hunter Transmission Project, valued at approximately $1.1 billion over three years. The scope covers about 110 kilometres of new double-circuit 500kV transmission line; planning is expected to begin in December 2026, with mobilisation in 2027 subject to approvals. The project is intended to increase renewable capacity, reduce network constraints and support coal-fired power-station retirements.

data.title: High-Grade Niobium Extends Beyond Green Resource
data.description:
The latest update is out from Encounter Resources Limited ( (AU:ENR) ).

Encounter Resources, a mineral exploration company undertaking niobium exploration, reported further thick, high-grade intersections from infill drilling at the Green Deposit in its Aileron Project, West Arunta. Aircore drilling east of the Green SW high-grade zone returned 25m at 3.8% Nb₂O₅ from 80m and 19m at 2.5% from 78m to end of hole, extending the potential starter-pit footprint eastward.

Other infill results included 14m at 4.2% Nb₂O₅ from 54m and 68.6m at 2.0% from 116.7m, including 6m at 3.7% from 120m; these results were above Green’s 1.6% Nb₂O₅ inferred MRE grade at a 1.0% cut-off. The release said the eastern zone remains open at depth, and diamond drilling has been completed there to test the full vertical extent of oxide mineralisation.

data.title: Heritage Survey Commences at Industrial Minerals’ North Pool Project
data.description:
Industrial Minerals Limited ( (AU:IND) ) has issued an update.

Industrial Minerals is a gold exploration company focused on its Laverton Gold Project, including the North Pool project. At North Pool, a heritage survey coordinated by Wangkatja Tjungula Aboriginal Corporation RNTBC has commenced as a work-area clearance by Nyalpa Pirniku Traditional Knowledge Holders.

The survey and Programme of Work approval, described as well advanced, are the key remaining steps before maiden drilling of a 1,700m magnetic–gravity target along the Chatterbox Shear, 1.5km along strike from Genesis Minerals’ Beasley Creek deposit, reported at 430 Koz @ 2.0 g/t Au. The target coincides with historic high-grade intercepts, including 1m @ 82.2 g/t Au and 4m @ 19.17 g/t Au, while the parties negotiate a Heritage Protection Agreement covering the company’s Laverton package within WTAC’s determination area.

data.title: Ipsen Advances Late-Stage Trial for New Wrinkle Treatment
data.description:
Ipsen (GB:0MH6) announced an update on their ongoing clinical study.

Study Overview: Ipsen is testing IPN10200, also called corabotase, in adults in China with moderate to severe lines between the eyebrows. The official title is “A Phase III, Multicentre, Double-blind, Randomised, Placebo-controlled, Parallel Group Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of IPN10200 in the Improvement of the Appearance of Moderate To Severe Glabellar Lines in Adult Chinese Participants.”

The study will assess whether one dose improves the appearance of these lines and remains safe over time. The trial is important because positive results could support Ipsen’s expansion in the large and competitive market for wrinkle treatments.

Intervention/Treatment: Participants receive one local injection of corabotase, a biological treatment, or a placebo with no active drug. Corabotase is intended to reduce the appearance of glabellar lines by acting on selected muscles between the eyebrows.

Study Design: This is a Phase III treatment study with participants assigned at random to either corabotase or placebo. Participants, study doctors, and those assessing results are not told which treatment was given, helping reduce bias.

Study Timeline: The registry does not list a study start date, primary completion date, or estimated completion date. The record was first submitted on August 19, 2026, and was last updated on November 19, 2026, showing that recruitment information remains active.

The study is recruiting and each participant may be followed for up to 55 weeks after the single injection. That long follow-up should provide information on both the treatment’s durability and its safety, although no study results have been posted.

Market Implications: The update offers limited immediate evidence for Ipsen’s stock, since it reports trial progress rather than clinical results. Still, continued recruitment in a late-stage study may support investor confidence in Ipsen’s aesthetic medicine pipeline.

Investor sentiment will likely depend on future efficacy, safety, and regulatory updates. The treatment is entering a crowded wrinkle-care market, where competition from established injectable products means clear benefits and reliable results will be important.

The study is ongoing and was updated on the ClinicalTrials portal, where further details are available.

To learn more about GB:0MH6’s potential, visit the Ipsen drug pipeline page.

data.title: Bama Tea Says Military Procurement Qualification Suspension Is Limited
data.description:
Bama Tea Co. Ltd. Class H ( (HK:6980) ) has shared an update.

Bama Tea Co., Ltd. is a joint stock company incorporated in the People’s Republic of China with limited liability; the release provides no further information on its industry, products, services or market focus.

The company said a notice published on the Military Procurement Network stated that its qualification to participate in procurement of supplies, projects and services across the military had been suspended. It said the measure concerns only military-procurement access management and does not involve product quality, food safety or day-to-day business operations, with no impact on sales, operations or core business activities serving the public; the group had not participated in military-related bidding.
